issues.title: `current_directional_atom_eligible` conflates applicability with full promotability
issues.affected: ddm_v550_authority_contract.py; ddm_v550_question_use.py; V551 directionality expectation helper
issues.defect: The same field is first used as a question/variable directional authority signal, but `derive_question_use_eligibility()` ultimately returns it as `bool(v551)`, where v551 includes semantic certification, response certification, structural completeness, review state, and other downstream conditions.
issues.evidence: ddm_v550_authority_contract.py returns `current_directional_atom_eligible: bool(v551)`; ddm_v550_question_use.py also gates the field through role/topology/authority conditions. The 9838527 helper calls this field the applicability denominator.
issues.consequence: Rows that are directionally applicable but fail stamping/mapping can disappear from the denominator, hiding exactly the repair debt V551 needs to expose.
issues.required: Introduce an immutable typed directional-applicability field derived from governing question/directionality authority before row-level promotability gates. Do not overwrite it with V551 eligibility.
tests: Applicable row with missing response map remains in denominator.
Review-required applicable row remains in denominator.

issues.title: Canonical signed projection is owned by multiple stages
issues.defect: V550 computes `v551_signed_*`, V551 also resolves/project signs and magnitudes, and V552 independently reconstructs signed representation again. The same semantic transformation has multiple engines.
issues.evidence: Runtime V550 `_scale_projection_fields`; accepted/runtime V551 scale projection; V552 scale/intensity resolution paths.
issues.consequence: Neutral, missing intensity, and ordinal coordinate semantics can diverge by stage; bug fixes must be repeated in multiple places.
issues.required: Make V551 the sole canonical signed-projection/adjudication boundary. V550 preserves raw response/authority identity; V552 consumes canonical V551 signed fields and never re-infers scale semantics.
tests: V552 output unchanged for complete clean cases when fed canonical V551 projection.
No V552 scale-family/coordinate inference remains authoritative.

issues.title: V550 scale authority loading is weaker than the governed V551 contract
issues.defect: V550 reads the registry without validating the companion manifest, registry hash, required schema, or authority geometry; it also builds response-family lookup keys alongside exact contract hashes.
issues.evidence: Runtime lines 51–80 load CSV directly and create both `(hash, ...)` and `(family, ...)` keys; accepted V551 loader hard-validates manifest/schema/hash.
issues.consequence: V550 can project from authority bytes that V551 itself would reject, and can mask missing exact identity through family fallback.
issues.required: Stop making V550 authoritative for signed projection. If V550 must read scale authority for compatibility metadata, use the same strict validated loader and exact identity semantics.
tests: Mutated manifest/hash blocks any compatibility read.

issues.title: V550 rereads/rebuilds the scale registry inside row projection
issues.defect: `_scale_projection_fields()` calls `_load_scale_encoding_registry()` per row, and the loader performs `pd.read_csv()` and rebuilds the lookup each call; there is no cache.
issues.consequence: Unnecessary I/O and repeated parsing amplify runtime cost and create more places for file-state drift during a run.
issues.required: Eliminate authoritative V550 projection. Any remaining authority loader must load/validate once per run and pass an immutable lookup/projector into row construction.
tests: One registry read per compiler run in instrumentation test.

issues.title: V550 cannot project certified neutral when raw intensity is absent
issues.defect: The runtime V550 projector requires both a certified direction and numeric `response_intensity` before projecting. A certified neutral with missing raw coordinate becomes unresolved even though neutral signed magnitude is definitionally zero.
issues.evidence: Runtime lines 97–110: direction must be positive/negative/neutral AND intensity must be non-null before returning signed fields.
issues.consequence: Old/existing shards can incorrectly block neutral evidence solely because raw source coordinate is absent.
issues.required: Canonical V551 compatibility logic must allow certified neutral → signed neutral/0.0 independent of raw intensity; raw intensity remains missing. V550 should cease owning canonical projection.
tests: Neutral + missing raw intensity → raw missing, signed neutral/0.0.

issues.title: Duplicate numeric-label helper definitions remain in V550 bridge
issues.defect: The module defines `_is_numeric_only_label`, `_response_family_allows_numeric_only_label`, and `_numeric_only_label_allowed` twice at top level.
issues.evidence: AST duplicate-function scan on runtime file.
issues.consequence: Later definitions silently shadow earlier ones; future edits can modify the dead copy and appear to have no effect.
issues.required: Delete/consolidate duplicate definitions after semantic repair is green; retain one tested implementation.
tests: AST scan reports zero duplicate top-level function names in touched modules.
